findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. Both machine views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. Add bounded replacement retries, as codex._record already does at src/forge/codex.py:528–539.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous P2 remains open. A structured missing-session result becomes error_during_execution followed by its diagnostic. The worker's prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:441–443 consequently misses it, while the reader checks stderr at src/forge/story.py:732 although this decoder returns the diagnostic through stdout. Both paths refuse instead of retrying with a fresh session. Recognize the missing-session diagnostic in both callers while preserving other failures. The response shape is shown in the [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609).
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
